name: mapping-constructor-expr-test-833706cb84/var-name-field-v.bal
spec_references: Module-level declarations: "Supports annotation values evaluated from constant and runtime expressions"

Expressions: "[Annotation access expression](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#annot-access-expr)"; the positive expression list does not include typeof expressions or object-constructor expressions.
reason: The whole case requires typeof serv1 and typeof serv2 to obtain typedesc values and assert runtime annotation values. typeof expressions are outside the supported expression list. The service object constructor expressions used to attach those annotations are also not listed. Mapping shorthand itself is covered, but these essential annotation checks make the whole case a feature request.
unsupported_constructs: typeof expressions used for service annotation inspection
test_design_notes: Assertions cover shorthand fields in records, maps and JSON, local/global lookup, and annotation values captured at different evaluation times.
lang.float NaN and value:toString are listed as supported; io:print is instrumentation.
